source: RFC 0004 §4.2, RFC 0009 (IDN-12) (usability review before RC1, UD-3)
statement: A subject.id literal beginning with ( (in eq, in or prefix, in any direction) and a principal binding whose principal id begins with ( do not compile. The anonymous principal has no subject.id in a document and matches no principal binding (BND-4), and no signed-in principal has a reserved id (IDN-12), so such a comparison never holds (and under a not holds for every anonymous request), and such a binding never applies. The message names subject.authenticated. Tenant ids beginning with ( stay valid.
guards: model:ConditionLintsTest#a subject id literal beginning with a parenthesis refuses in every direction
engine:PolicyCompilerTest#a reserved subject id literal does not compile
document:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#no principal binding names a reserved id
